injuries.name: Puka Nacua
injuries.note: Nacua suffered a knee injury during Sunday's 20-13 win at Washington and will undergo an MRI on Monday to determine its extent, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

injuries.name: Terrance Ferguson
injuries.note: Coach Sean McVay noted Sunday that Ferguson pulled his hamstring during Friday's practice and will likely be sidelined for another couple of weeks, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Steve Avila
injuries.note: Avila (hamstring) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's matchup against the Commanders.

injuries.name: Joe Cardona
injuries.note: Cardona (ankle) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Commanders.

injuries.name: Ty Simpson
injuries.note: Simpson (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Rams' emergency third quarterback in Sunday's game against the Commanders, Stu Jackson of the Rams' official site reports.
